verdict.rationale: Base44 docs show built-in AI agents and Superagents that can update records, trigger workflows, and connect to tools (docs-6, docs-43, docs-45-51) without requiring the user to supply provider credentials, suggesting managed LLM access is baked into the platform. However, docs-49 explicitly describes connecting to external AI services (OpenAI, Claude, Groq, Mistral) 'that use an API key,' implying key management is still exposed for non-default providers, and there's no explicit statement that the default in-app agents fully abstract provider key handling. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that default AI agents use Base44-managed keys with zero key exposure, and independent/hands-on corroboration of this specific claim.
